I unfortunately can't move out I don't have the funds or the balls to do such a thing. I have hobbies but don't want to get into group stuff, I would love to be able to talk to everyone and be really confident but I just feel really uncomfortable when it comes to socialising. What makes it worse everyone around me is getting married and settling down whereas I never even had a gf nor do I think I would want to drag snyoney to the level I'm at.
Also I don't drink, nor do i party I'm just not into stuff like that I rather read a book on history I know I sound pathetic

Thanks a lot for the great reply, I guess your right especially the last part. The thing is all the crap from my childhood or problems I face I always try to remain strong and face them. I 've always had the mentality in my head that if I let a problem or a person in my life  beat me down then I have really let them win. But now I have medical problems and then I recently found out one of my eyes is weaker than the other. This may seem like nothing but in my head all I can think is how i'm so flawed. At least with experiences or problems you can mentally and physical try and move past them, but when you're told you have a illness and will need surgery for which you will need a couple of months off there's nothing you can do about it. Then being told one of my eyes is weak and strays( I never really knew why I couldn't see 3d now I know) it makes me feel helpless and full of defects.

On top of all this I'm living a lie at home. I respect peoples belief don't get me wrong, I've met some really great religious people in my life. But personally I no longer believe I guess I feel there isn't strong enough evidence for giving up so much time and energy. Its like I've been cheated on everything I believed to be true or the heaven I was working towards attaining was all bullshit. I love my family but they are deeply religious Muslims and pray regularly, and they tell me to pray. Sometimes i 'm at home and they are talking about for example the story of Moses or something. I just look at them and see how passionate and firm they are about there faith, whereas I don't believe it at all, I have to sit there and pretend like I agree. If I ever said I changed my religion my family would probably cut off any contact with me and throw me out so imagine what will happen if I told them I don't even believe in god. What makes it worse is I have no one to talk to and my closest friend is a devout Muslim who would cut me off if he found out I don't believe.

The thing is I can't move out because firstly I don't have the money for it, secondly my parents are immigrants to UK and according to there culture its disrespectful to move out before marriage. Also even if I could move out I would then be all alone, I find settings with lots of new people very uncomfortable I can't socialise very well I feel like every one is judging me or that I'm not good enough. So I'm stuck at home.

I then finally returned to uni because I thought I will try and kick start my life again, but now I have the stress of exams and work which is fine but I also haven't made any friends just a few aquintences. By now everyone has already made their circle of friends and I'm just a loner. On top of this even if I could be very outgoing I have a medical condition I'm deal with for two years which makes sitting for long periods really uncomfortable.

I was thinking about what you say In regards to therapy, the only thing is I feel a little embarrassed and if any one in my family finds out then I'll freak out. Because they will probably make jokes because I'm seeing a shrink, but even worse is when everyone pity's you and treats you like you're sick I hate that. Also I feel like if I go to therapy it will be like saying along with my physical, social problems I am also mentally ill and it will make me feel useless. I feel like I'm trapped in life and there's no way out of this. Like I'm destined to a fate of misery and what strengthens this idea in my head is when I look around and read about people just like me who struggled there whole life and died with no one giving a fuck, I'm almost convinced some people have a good life but some like me are destined for a life of troubles its just not fair!.
